steps.title: Open the Playbook Signals page
steps.narration: Let's start by confirming the main Playbook Signals page loads without errors. This is our baseline check.
steps.point_out: The Playbook Signals heading is visible at the top, and the page has fully loaded.

steps.title: Check the Microscope Readiness section
steps.narration: Next, we'll scroll down and open the Microscope Readiness section at the bottom of the page to see the corpus summary tables.
steps.point_out: After expanding, you should see the Corpus Totals table and the Legacy Tick Shards data, confirming the product still has access to its diagnostic datasets.

steps.title: Visit the Cockpit page
steps.narration: Now let's check the Cockpit dashboard. We'll verify it loads and shows the empty state before a ticker is watched.
steps.point_out: The Cockpit page is ready, and you should see the text 'No ticker watched' showing the empty state.

steps.title: Watch a test ticker in the Cockpit
steps.narration: Let's watch a ticker to confirm the real-time quote and tape features still work. We'll use the SIM-BUYER symbol.
steps.point_out: After watching, the page should show 'Buyer Control' confirming the simulation data is flowing and the watch flow is operational.

steps.title: Confirm the watch is active
steps.narration: Click the Watch button to activate the ticker watch.
steps.point_out: You should see 'Buyer Control' appear, confirming the watch is working and live data is streaming.

steps.title: Open the Structure page
steps.narration: Let's check the Structure page to see the Tradable Map feature. This shows the support and resistance bands.
steps.point_out: The Tradable Map heading should appear, showing the page is ready to load structure data.

steps.title: Load a specific Tradable Map
steps.narration: We'll load the S/R bands for AAPL as of June 22, 2026, which is a key data point for our testing.
steps.point_out: The band range '300.11–302.2' should appear after loading, confirming the structure engine is computing correctly.

steps.title: Set the date for the structure lookup
steps.narration: Now we'll set the date to June 22, 2026, 5 PM ET, to match our reference data.
steps.point_out: The as-of date field should accept this timestamp.

steps.title: Load the structure data
steps.narration: Click the Load button to retrieve the Tradable Map for these parameters.
steps.point_out: The support-resistance band should appear, showing the product is correctly computing structure levels.

steps.title: Return to Playbook Signals
steps.narration: Let's go back to the Desk page to verify the Playbook Evidence section and other core surfaces.
steps.point_out: We're back on the Desk page with the Playbook Signals heading visible.

steps.title: Open the Playbook Evidence section
steps.narration: We'll open the Playbook Evidence section to confirm it's rendering real signals from our recorded playbook.
steps.point_out: The section should expand and show 'Built from signature:' text, indicating real playbook data is being served.

steps.title: Filter Playbook Evidence by date
steps.narration: Let's filter the playbook signals to June 22, 2026, to see the real signals for that date.
steps.point_out: After entering the date, the text 'recorded signals, none hidden' should appear, confirming the filter is working.

steps.title: Check the Referee Registry
steps.narration: Now let's open the Referee Registry section to confirm the configuration fingerprint is frozen.
steps.point_out: The section should show 'config fingerprint 08e471b10130e1e2', confirming that the frozen configuration foundation is in place.

steps.title: Verify Referee Adjudications is empty
steps.narration: Let's check the Referee Adjudications section to confirm there are no hypotheses registered yet.
steps.point_out: This section should show 'No hypotheses registered', which is the correct honest-empty state.

steps.title: Verify Referee Runs is empty
steps.narration: Finally, let's check the Referee Runs section to confirm there are no evaluation runs yet.
steps.point_out: This section should show 'No evaluation runs recorded yet.', which is the correct honest-empty state for a fresh configuration.
